info.title: comtrade
info.description: APIs to get trade data and metadata. Free/Premium subscription key is required.

get.description: Extract trade data in a basic layout. See the detailed description at https://uncomtrade.org/docs/list-of-references-parameter-codes/

parameters.name: typeCode
parameters.description: Type of trade: C for commodities and S for service

parameters.name: freqCode
parameters.description: Trade frequency: A for annual and M for monthly

parameters.name: clCode
parameters.description: Product classifications: HS, SITC, BEC (for goods) or EBOPS (for services).

parameters.name: reporterCode
parameters.description: Reporter code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Year or month. Year should be 4 digit year. Month should be six digit integer with the values of the form YYYYMM. Ex: 201002 for 2010 February. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: partnerCode
parameters.description: Partner code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: partner2Code
parameters.description: Second partner/consignment code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: cmdCode
parameters.description: Product (commodity/service category) code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: flowCode
parameters.description: Trade flow code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,)) Allowed values (case-insensitive): M, X, RX, RM, MIP, XIP, MOP, XOP, MIF, XIF, DX, FM. Omit to not filter.

parameters.name: customsCode
parameters.description: Customs code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,)) Allowed values: C00, C01, C02, C03, C04, C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C10, C11, C12, C13, C14, C15, C20. Omit to not filter.

parameters.name: motCode
parameters.description: Mode of transport code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,)) Allowed values: 0, 1000, 2000, 2100, 2200, 2900, 3000, 3100, 3200, 3900, 9000, 9100, 9110, 9120, 9190, 9200, 9300, 9900. Omit to not filter.

parameters.name: aggregateBy
parameters.description: Add parameters in csv list on which you want the results to be aggregated. Comma-separated list of: cmdCode, period, partnerCode, partner2Code, reporterCode, customsCode, motCode

parameters.name: breakdownMode
parameters.description: Breakdown mode to choose from

parameters.name: includeDesc
parameters.description: Include descriptions of data variables

get.description:
The MBS data API gives users access to historical time series of MBS trade tables, notably Tables 38 and 35. Data availability and frequency of update depend on data series.
T35 Total trade - value (1946-)
T38 Conversion factors (1946-)

parameters.name: series_type
parameters.description:
Combination of table number, frequency, type of measurement and currenty. T35.Q.V.$
T35.A.V.$
T38.Q.CF.
T38.A.CF.
T35.M.V.$
T38.M.CF.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Reference year (default = any):The reference year of period. As an example: 2015,2016

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Country code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Year or month. Year should be 4 digit year. Month should be six digit integer with the values of the form YYYYMM. Ex: 201002 for 2010 February. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description:
data set frequency: Valid values:
A Annual
Q Quarterly
M Monthly

parameters.name: table_type
parameters.description: (default = any) MBS Table numbers: MBS table identifier.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format (default = json): Valid value are json, txt or csv

200.description: Success (JSON by default; CSV/TXT when format is set)

schema.description: format=csv: comma-separated, UTF-8 with BOM, header row = data field names.
format=txt: tab-separated, UTF-8 with BOM, header row = data field names.
